scope: Qualified adoption on reopen and cooperative publication (I09–I11). Internal epoch returns belong to EpochValidation.

stateVariables.writer,lease: Per-controller read baseline, observed input, phase, retry and cooperative writer lease.
stateVariables.input,disk,blocks: Input content version, physical index identity and staged payloads.
stateVariables.reader,adopted: One reopened reader; snapshot of qualification at adoption.
stateVariables.lastCommit: Baseline, live bytes, input and block existence at commit.

initialState: Arbitrary previous envelope in valid storage with independently valid/invalid content, owner evidence and reference binding.
assumptions: Physical digests abstracted to unique revisions (no ABA); immutable blocks, cooperating writers only. Owner and reference evidence are independent predicates; no OS atomicity or decoder proof.

safety.CurrentAdoption: Restored graph qualifies against the reader observation.
safety.PhysicalCAS: Old baseline cannot replace a competitor index.
safety.CurrentCommit: Commit at matching input with write permission.
safety.IndexLast: All indexed blocks exist at commit.
safety.NoPublishedHit: Reachability control for warm use of a newly published graph.

liveness: None: no caller or external-process completion guarantee.
fairness: None; terminal stuttering represents quiescence only.

bounds.dimensions: 1–2 writers, 2 input versions, 8 seed envelopes, 1 reader, 1 retry per writer.
bounds.pruning: None: no state/action constraints, symmetry or view filtering.

counterexamples: Mutants discard one independent qualification. Physical faults outside cooperative lease and process crashes are not covered.
